title: Find the Minimum and Maximum Number of Nodes Between Critical Points
goal: Find minimum and maximum index distances between linked-list critical points.
strategy: A critical point is a strict local peak or valley. Adjacent critical positions give the minimum distance, while the first and last give the maximum.
